title: Design, Synthesis, and Applications of Fluorescent Amino Acids in Bioimaging.
snippet: Fluorescent unnatural amino acids (FlAAs) provide a powerful molecular bridge between small-molecule fluorophores and biomacromolecules, enabling minimally perturbative optical interrogation of peptides and proteins.
